description: This file defines a React-like component for editing a recipe, including logic for loading, editing, and submitting recipe data, as well as navigation and error handling.

methods.name: component$
methods.description: Defines the main functional component for the edit recipe page.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the recipe data by ID from the API, with loading and error handling.

methods.name: useVisibleTask$
methods.description: Triggers the load function when the component becomes visible.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission to update the recipe via API and navigates back to the recipe detail page.
